title: Research: bound rounded QQ16 producer errors with bounded dirty helpers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the literal QQ16 F0→B_1_2 pair, a completed-operation relative tolerance `u <= 2^(-beta-delta-102)` is sufficient for PR #2965's two stage-output allowances when original data norms are at most H and dirty-helper norms are at most `2^delta H`, for integers `beta, delta >= 0`. The error ledger permits nonzero ADD, SCALE, child, adapter and cover-map defects, preserves exact private CLEARs, and carries actual helper error from F0 into B1.

The new package is `research/qq16-rounded-producer-envelope/`: a conditional interface proof, exact finite certificate and standalone checks. It reproduces and credits the retained Horner magnitude bounds; the new delta is the relative-defect derivative ledger and noisy two-stage composition. Separate tolerances `u_F <= 2^(-beta-delta-71)` and `u_B <= 2^(-beta-delta-102)` also suffice. With PR #2965's separate decoder allowance `epsD <= H 2^(-beta-1)`, its inherited completed-output theorem gives decoded error at most `(7587/8192) H 2^-beta`.

This is not a finite register-width theorem or an implementation meeting the local contracts. Exact helper-bit restoration, native internal arithmetic, physical hosting/movement and an affordable F17 consumer remain open. No child tariff, scalar word, supplier admission, selected frontier or kappa changes.

## Task and overlap

Task card: `joint-query-controller`, track `recursive-interfaces`, priority revision 6; catalogue scope key `42581d429acc9509d503`, refined scope `qq16-f0-b12-rounded-completed-operations-dirty-bounded`. The complete card is in the package's `TASK.json`. Its `existing_checks` was empty, meaning unknown coverage.

- **Question/domain:** quantify completed-operation error and intermediate norms on all 712 fields and all 26,099 F0 / 27,019 B1 events, for arbitrary positive payload tensor depth under the inherited native isometry and sweep contracts. Integers beta, delta are nonnegative; private initial dirt is arbitrary and cleared before use.
- **Method:** exact positive path polynomials at z=1 and their five relative-defect derivatives; a separate integer implementation checks all P/J cuts, and reverse adjoints check category totals. Native maps are bounded by their norms; no signed physical-state identity replacement is used.
- **Scope status:** refined to one conditional producer/dirty-state implication in [PR #2965's handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-18975580). [The claim is in discussion #2727](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-19001931).
- **Milestone and stopping rule:** scoped interface lemma and finite certificate; stop after the numerical implication. The existing operation counts remain liabilities. Actual arithmetic, exact helper return, ownership, movement, storage, recursive tariffs, centre/coverage convention and F17 consumption remain unknown; no favorable complete cost is claimed.
- **Success/falsification:** complete source-bound cut coverage, separately implemented arithmetic agreement, explicit noisy-helper carry, and rejected omitted-defect/ownership/feedback mutants. A missing operation, unsupported native contract or uncharged extra handoff invalidates use of the resulting tolerance.

Exact scientific/submission base: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Canonical main was refreshed at 2026-10-17 17:46:17 UTC and again at 17:57:59 UTC; both checks found main unchanged and priority revision 6. Frozen inputs are preserved.

Nearest overlaps: [#3181](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3181), head `80fc72d14546088e9fce3c06dc12bc67270da0af`, computes signed scalar-projection cancellation/grid/adjoint quantities; this result charges nonzero scalar errors in a positive native-norm envelope. [#3189](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3189), head `70537595e46444c8a63455523d9851a5efe55385`, audits child-error lattice closure; no lattice or single-direction native lift is claimed here. [#3017](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3017), head `0f493f4c264fbc70ee14364b68af260d858c143c`, establishes a dirty-input obstruction, and [#3067](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3067), head `e1e28b4070ae52efa5a9d0aa826bc588be7206f2`, supplies concrete F0 rounding evidence. This result adds a sufficient bounded-dirty contract for the pair. Two concurrent PRs on the same card have different premises and outputs: [#3226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3226), head `6b17b9b7c76d60726bd87123b9bf9905aa3151dd`, proves an exact fixed grid for F0 alone (every primitive exact, no B1), and [#3216](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3216), head `af5b2ff1c0afa3100c961fa11b4d6e1fe18714cb`, lifts one #3189 B1 error direction through the native suffix. ## Validation

Standard-library CPython 3.12.3, Linux x86_64:

```sh
python3 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-rounded-producer-envelope --check-only
python3 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-rounded-producer-envelope
```

Both pass; the full replay takes about 10 seconds. `python3 -Werror -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qq16-rounded-producer-envelope` also confirms all 15 package/input files match the committed bytes. The registered replay runs the complete primary checker normally and with `-O`, the separate integer/adjoint checker, and optimized behavioral tests. Principal markers:

```text
PASS_QQ16_ROUNDED_PRODUCER_ENVELOPE stages=2 cuts=53098 offset=102 conditional_completed_operations no_new_kappa
PASS_QQ16_PRODUCER_ENVELOPE_INDEPENDENT integer_cuts=53098 reverse_rows=6 categories=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-rounded-producer-envelope outcome=completed
```

Exact evidence: 53,098 changed-field cuts; 53,034 permitted defect sites; the same complete P/J digest in rational and integer arithmetic; six reverse covectors matching five category totals; source-derived calibration of the inherited F0 endpoint bound 58. The all-cut/terminal data derivative bounds are `J_F = 10632335516156845470267/4096 < 2^62` and `J_B = 34778728470688788237067911/8 < 2^82`.

Ten behavioral groups cover noncommuting isometries with coherent state-dependent errors, explicit positive polynomials, omitted feedback, dirty magnitude and noisy helper reuse, omitted native/map defects, erased private transients, ownership/uninitialized reads, invalid private sweep contents, scalar coefficient changes, exact tolerance inequalities, endpoint geometry and source corruption. A Git-free export passes direct optimized replay. Native physical semantics are inherited, not re-certified by these toy fixtures. The selected cold replay, full native operator replay and formal-kernel verification were not run. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json specify three follow-ups: implement one finite, priced completed native-child/scratch contract; decide and meet exact borrowed-helper restoration if required; and join a concrete F17 consumer and owner/sweep schedule to the full recursive invoice, including centre coverage. Start at an actual child/half-ADD interface and retain scalar rounding in the budget. The current result supplies conditional error allowances, not those implementation or cost premises. No further dependent search is proposed.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The current priority correctly points from decoder constants to producer obligations. The card's empty `existing_checks` requires reading a dense numerical chain to distinguish ideal grids, child-defect grids and primitive finite formats. A short coverage entry linking #2965, #3181 and #3189 would make the remaining implication easier to select without repeating existing work.
